# UseMoney - AI/LLM Crawler Guidance
# https://usemoney.ai

## About
UseMoney is an AI-powered trading portfolio management platform for Indian stock markets.
It provides multi-broker integration, portfolio analytics, paper trading, FIRE planning tools,
and educational content for retail investors in India.

## Contact
Website: https://usemoney.ai
Support: support@usemoney.ai

## Public Content (Crawlable)

### Static Pages
- https://usemoney.ai/ - Landing page
- https://usemoney.ai/pricing - Subscription plans and pricing
- https://usemoney.ai/privacy - Privacy policy
- https://usemoney.ai/terms - Terms of service

### Blog
- https://usemoney.ai/blog - Blog listing (investing, trading strategies, portfolio management)
- https://usemoney.ai/blog/{slug} - Individual blog posts

### Newsletter
- https://usemoney.ai/newsletter - Newsletter archive (market insights, trading strategies)
- https://usemoney.ai/newsletter/{slug} - Individual newsletter issues

### Financial Glossary
- https://usemoney.ai/glossary - Financial terms glossary (stock market, trading, investment terminology)
- https://usemoney.ai/glossary/{slug} - Individual glossary term definitions

### Documentation
- https://usemoney.ai/docs - Platform documentation and guides
- https://usemoney.ai/docs/{slug} - Individual documentation pages

## Crawling Guidelines
- All routes listed above are publicly accessible and may be indexed
- All other routes require authentication and should NOT be indexed
- API endpoints (/api/*) are not for public consumption
- Sitemap available at: https://usemoney.ai/sitemap.xml

## Features
- Multi-broker integration (Zerodha, Upstox, Angel One, Groww, Dhan, Fyers)
- Portfolio tracking and analytics across all brokers
- Trade book with FIFO pairing and CSV import
- Paper trading simulator with real-time market data
- FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) calculator
- AI-powered portfolio analysis, research, and market insights
- Risk analysis (VaR, drawdown, correlation)
- Portfolio roast (AI-powered portfolio scoring)
- Stock and mutual fund discovery
- Watchlist management
- Tax analysis
- Educational content (blog, glossary, newsletters, documentation)

## Technology
Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and deployed on Vercel.
Database: MongoDB Atlas. AI: Google Gemini. Payments: Dodo Payments.
